ops.old: Dust 600g flathead in chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry until just cooked. Dice half a pineapple with a little red onion and lime for salsa. Mix sour cream with lime for a crema. Fill corn tortillas with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.
ops.new: Dust 600g cod in chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry until just cooked. Dice half a pineapple with a little red onion and lime for salsa. Mix sour cream with lime for a crema. Fill corn tortillas with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

ops.old: Dust the flathead fillets in the chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry in the oil until just cooked. Flake into pieces.
ops.new: Dust the cod fillets in the chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry in the oil until just cooked. Flake into pieces.
